'''Pyther's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]]. She and her [[Pyther's father|husband]] both died when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] abandoned the planet and led the Empire take over, prompting their son [[Pyther]] to join the [[Balmorran resistance]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pyther's mother is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Balmorra.
